title: Missing moeb tool: Read
description: Used the Claude Code native Read tool to read the mcp__moeb__start_run tool result file (161K+ characters saved to a local path by the system due to output size). No moeb equivalent exists for reading oversized tool result files redirected to local file paths.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a moeb equivalent of the Read tool covering reading of large system-generated result files from local paths when tool output exceeds the in-memory result limit.
